description_en: Queries the Simple Log Service (SLS) delivery configurations of the current account
description_zh: 查询当前账号的日志服务 SLS 投递配置
name: DescribeSlsDeliveryConfig

fields.help_en: The query condition for the product type to which the logs belong. If you specify this parameter, delivery scopes are filtered by the specified product type. The value must be consistent with the existing delivery configurations. For example, `WuyingServer` indicates Enterprise Edition workstations
fields.help_zh:
日志所属产品类型的查询条件。填写后按该产品类型筛选，应与已有投递配置一致。

例如，`WuyingServer` 表示企业版工作站
fields.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: Filters delivery scopes by the product type to which the logs belong. If this parameter is omitted or an empty list is passed, delivery scopes are not filtered by product type
parameters.help_zh: 按日志所属产品类型筛选投递范围。省略或传入空列表时，不按产品类型筛选
parameters.name: delivery_scopes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SLS project is located. Exact match is used. If this parameter is omitted, delivery scopes are not filtered by region
parameters.help_zh: SLS Project 所在地域的标识，精确匹配。省略时不按地域筛选
parameters.name: sls_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SLS project. Exact match is used. If this parameter is omitted, delivery scopes are not filtered by project name
parameters.help_zh: SLS Project 名称，精确匹配。省略时不按 Project 名称筛选
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the SLS Logstore. Exact match is used. If this parameter is omitted, delivery scopes are not filtered by Logstore name
parameters.help_zh: SLS Logstore 名称，精确匹配。省略时不按 Logstore 名称筛选
parameters.name: log_store_name

schema.description_en: The log delivery configuration query result
schema.description_zh: 日志投递配置查询结果

DeliveryConfigs.description_en: The list of delivery configurations that match the filter conditions. If no configurations match the conditions, an empty list is returned
DeliveryConfigs.description_zh: 匹配筛选条件的投递配置列表。无匹配配置时为空列表

items.description_en: The delivery configuration of an SLS project
items.description_zh: 一个 SLS Project 的投递配置

LogStores.description_en: The list of Logstore delivery configurations under the project
LogStores.description_zh: 该 Project 下的 Logstore 投递配置列表

items.description_en: The delivery configuration of a Logstore
items.description_zh: 一个 Logstore 的投递配置

DeliveryScopes.description_en: The product delivery scopes of the Logstore and the delivery status of each scope
DeliveryScopes.description_zh: 该 Logstore 的产品投递范围及各范围的投递状态

items.description_en: The delivery configuration of a product scope
items.description_zh: 一个产品范围的投递配置

ProductType.description_en: The product type of the delivery scope. For example, `WuyingServer` indicates Enterprise Edition workstations
ProductType.description_zh: 该投递范围的产品类型。例如，`WuyingServer` 表示企业版工作站

Status.description_en:
The current status of the delivery configuration. Valid values:
`Stopped`: Delivery is stopped.
`Enabled`: Delivery is enabled.
`AbnormalLogstoreDeleted`: The destination Logstore is deleted, and delivery is abnormal.
`AbnormalProjectDeleted`: The destination project is deleted, and delivery is abnormal
Status.description_zh:
投递配置的当前状态。

`Stopped`：已停止投递。
`Enabled`：已启用投递。
`AbnormalLogstoreDeleted`：目标 Logstore 已删除，投递异常。
`AbnormalProjectDeleted`：目标 Project 已删除，投递异常

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the destination SLS Logstore
LogStoreName.description_zh: 投递目标的 SLS Logstore 名称

Ttl.description_en: The data retention period configured for the destination Logstore, in days
Ttl.description_zh: 投递目标 Logstore 配置的数据保留时长，单位为天

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the destination SLS project
ProjectName.description_zh: 投递目标的 SLS Project 名称

SlsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the destination SLS project is located
SlsRegionId.description_zh: 投递目标 SLS Project 所在的地域标识

RequestId.description_en: The request ID used to locate the current call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，用于定位本次调用
